exposure: First caesarean delivery vs subsequent caesarean delivery
cohort: 63 pregnant women who underwent transendometrial myomectomy during their first caesarean delivery and had a subsequent live pregnancy with planned elective repeat caesarean delivery
finding: The novel transendometrial approach for caesarean myomectomy may improve the obstetric outcomes of subsequent pregnancy without causing any additional immediate and long-term adverse surgical outcomes.
mod_finding: Performing a transendometrial myomectomy during a cesarean section may lead to improved obstetric outcomes in subsequent pregnancies without increasing surgical risks.
